brief.t: Hunter Amenities is the largest deal in the building: 80,000 conditioner units per month. Sam is at $1.75 batch and fill, but Aidan still owes real fill, labor, and overhead costing; Q-0065 shows that line at $0.00.
Call Riley at Twincraft to thank him and ask what else is in his overflow. He has referred Cory Anderson, Newell Brands, and Amanda Peters—the best acquisition channel PLL has.
Newell Brands has had no follow-up since the Sep 15 call, and Amanda Peters reached out Sep 21 and is still unanswered. Clear both before moving to Honcho next steps.

Honcho is three SKUs—two scented and one unscented—with roughly 30,000 to 35,000 opening units, not seven SKUs or 15,000 total. Cory targets $2.25–$3.25 per finished filled unit; Twincraft MOQ is 20,000 per scent.
The quote desk is the R2150 choke point: 15 requests went to Aidan since Sep 16, only one came back; 54 CRM quotes exist, 50 are still drafts, and zero have ever been sent.
The Email Agent backslash-n bug is still live; a corrupted link went out Sep 21 at 7:04 PM and Delphos House has received four dead join links. Sam has not authorized a hard send time block.
Fireflies is connected with 23 recorded calls available. Google Ads nightly refresh failed Sep 21 with zero campaigns and accounts; the last verified Ads cache remains unchanged.
